description: TERMINAL CapDetail-guard redirect (record-09): goto(the record's CapDetail link) lands on a state whose reported url is Error.aspx (an invalid/broken-record redirect, :199). The guard `contains(lower(pageUrl()),'capdetail.aspx')` is false -> terminal record_not_accessible, NOT retried. gotoUrl is the CapDetail link so goto() resolves here; url is the Error page and carries NO 'capdetail.aspx' substring (a Login.aspx redirect whose ReturnUrl echoes the CapDetail path would instead slip past the :203 guard and fail terminally at the record-number guard -- also not retried; documented in FIXTURE_NOTES). No Chromium, no live traffic.
